description: Historical executable precursor of the NEXUS CORTEX research workflow lineage in welcome-to-github, preserved from repository commit a01c6e8df1f5e8ba80726ede6cbdb5de692e8741 on 2026-02-15. This daily GitHub Actions workflow harvested external evidence, produced dated intelligence artifacts, and opened a pull request for human review rather than applying its findings directly. It established an early observe–record–review pattern, but was named Brain Evolution and must not be retrospectively presented as a version of the later NEXUS CORTEX Life Cycle. The canonical executable is .github/workflows/brain_evolution.yml at the recorded Git commit; the AGI lineage record preserves its identity and recovery evidence without containing a second executable copy.
name: Brain Evolution — welcome-to-github
